Subject: Discovery recap + pick a 30-min demo time

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce average inference latency for clinical summarization workflows (200–400 tokens) while keeping per-token cost under $0.003.
- Constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flows, requirement for VPC/private deployment for eventual Prod, and a preference for minimal engineering lift for a POC.
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 450ms, basic eval pass rate on our sample prompts, and a demo that includes a short technical architecture sketch for VPC deployment.

Next step: 30-minute product walkthrough (high-level + technical touchpoints). I’ve proposed three windows below — pick whichever works best and I’ll send a calendar invite:

Option A: Thu, Nov 19 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (ideal for product + security)
Option B: Fri, Nov 20 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT (technical deep-dive friendly)
Option C: Mon, Nov 23 — 9:30–10:00 AM PT (early in the week for key stakeholders)

If none of these work I can send a one-click Calendly link. I’ve attached my discovery notes and a short slide with the VPC checklist.

Attachments: discovery-notes-acme-20261117.pdf (summary + sample prompts)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
